CREATE TABLE `libraries` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`workspace_id` text NOT NULL,
	`display_name` text NOT NULL,
	`source_kind` text NOT NULL,
	`source_path` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT `fk_libraries_workspace_id_workspaces_id_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`workspace_id`) REFERENCES `workspaces`(`id`),
	CONSTRAINT "libraries_display_name" CHECK(length("display_name") > 0),
	CONSTRAINT "libraries_source_kind" CHECK("source_kind" = 'local-fs')
);
CREATE TABLE `workspaces` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY,
	`display_name` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer NOT NULL,
	CONSTRAINT "workspaces_display_name" CHECK(length("display_name") > 0)
);
CREATE INDEX `libraries_workspace_id` ON `libraries` (`workspace_id`);
